body:
Lexer-level start on LO_Formal_Grammar_Phase_0_Complete.md's larger PCRE literal/class/range/escape grammar (§19-29). New tokens LITERAL(🔤)/CLASS(🅰️)/NCLASS(🚫)/RANGE(↔️)/ESCAPE(🛡️). LITERAL requires a real quoted-text payload (new lexQuotedText helper, new Token.Text field); resolved a real, undocumented ambiguity in the source doc (no whitespace allowed between 🔤 and its opening quote, no backslash-escapes inside quotes, unterminated quote is fatal) and flagged the decision in GRAMMAR.md rather than guessing silently. Parser/emitter support for the actual Pattern grammar and MATCH's string-typed subject remain a real, separate follow-up. 4 new lexer tests, 32 tests total, GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 4549f02.

⚓ ☃
title: LITERAL/CLASS/NCLASS/RANGE/ESCAPE lexer tokens
